item.title: Six Years Without Reinstalling Fedora: When 65 GiB Free Wasn't Enough
item.description:
This Fedora installation has been upgraded in place since Fedora 33. The rescue initramfs on this ThinkPad is dated 26 December 2020, and the same installation is now running Fedora 44 with 7.2.x kernels in /boot. More importantly, its Btrfs filesystem was created at the same time and has never been reformatted.

Both / and /home are Btrfs subvolumes on the same 475.4 GiB nvme0n1p3 partition. The operating system, containers, caches, user data, and build trees therefore compete for one storage pool that carries nearly six years of allocation history.
